description: Curated 12-question intake for the Presentation Interview app. Every question id, prompt, kind, allowed_values, value_labels and storeOn is derived from the canonical 23-ai-workforce-blueprint/templates/role-library/presentations/intake/deck-intake-questions.json (v1.3.0) so the bridge can replay each answer through deck-intake-driver.py and the dept's _chk_intake provenance gate passes. Custom capture questions (logo, image_links) carry their own ids but are mapped to deck_brief fields by intake_writer.py. Cap 20; this set is 12. Progress label is 'Question N of 12'.

questions.prompt: What are you SELLING at the end — the exact name of the product or offer?
questions.help: The OFFER sold at the end of the presentation — never invented.

questions.prompt: What's the before-and-after this offer delivers — who are they before, and who are they after?
questions.help: The transformation promise drives the whole arc. Example: 'stuck and overwhelmed' to 'clear, confident, and closing'.

questions.prompt: Who is this presentation for? Tell us about your audience — the pain point that brought them here.
questions.help: Industry, income level, and the specific pain that brought them. This seeds the audience-engine.

questions.prompt: What is the exact call-to-action — the specific verb and next step you want them to take?
questions.help: Example: 'book a call', 'buy the program', 'join the waitlist'. This drives the closing slide.

questions.prompt: Do you have a logo or brand colors you want on the slides?
questions.help: If no logo is on file, provide one here or we build without one and stay on-brand to the presentation system.

questions.prompt: Paste any image links you want used in the deck. (Optional — add up to 5.)
questions.help: Product photos, headshots, brand imagery. We source images through the approved image pipeline; links here are used as grounded references.

questions.prompt: Pick a tone — Inspirational, Tough Love, Challenger, Teacher, Storyteller, High-Energy Hype, or Calm Premium. You can also blend two.
questions.help: One of the seven named styles, or a blend of two.

questions.prompt: What is the final price of the offer?
questions.help: The OFFER price only — what a buyer pays at the end. Set 0 only if this is a free-only close.

questions.prompt: At what pace should we record the audio narration?
questions.help: default = our recommended setting (1.25), medium = 1.3, fast = 1.33.

questions.prompt: Do you need me to create a sales page and a checkout page to go along with your presentation?
questions.help: Default YES. A 'no' records a client waiver — you keep the deck and optionally a VSL page.

value_labels.yes: Yes, build the sales page and checkout page

questions.prompt: Would you like a VSL page — a video sales letter page — to go along with this?
questions.help: Default NO — a VSL page needs the video to exist first. Say yes only if a hosted video is in scope.

questions.prompt: Anything else important we should know before we start?
questions.help: Extras: target slide count, deadline, proof assets, or anything else. Optional.
